doc.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: Who gets the solos in the Basie band
summary: Solo assignments are up to the bandleader.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Was there a certain etiquette among the players about getting the solos? How did you decide between you. You and Frank Foster were on the band—
Well that’s up to the band leader.
That’s up to the band leader?
Yeah. He says you take this and you take that. It’s up to him, you know.
